preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of roads m must be at least n-1 and at most 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) % (10**9 + 7) == int(x) for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be the remainder of the smallest number modulo 10^9+7.
Each output integer must be greater than zero.
